investigation.interpretation: A common control/publication interruption preceded the client stop by about 207 ms. Stable pre-gap attitude and stopped inference logging support a control-loop stall. No final-command or rosout topics were recorded, so exact stall location and whether damping contributed to the physical fall remain unproved.
investigation.earlier_turn_gaps: Recorder receipt delays only: IMU source stamps advanced normally across those gaps. Do not cite these as control-loop stalls.
investigation.command_contract: Pinned stock actor and native libraries verified before run; requested/applied lateral input +0.15 m/s matched. No game buttons or policy switch. Selected source archive neural_controller.cpp SHA ea05d804e4376785fa573c6ac0a77f15e9e26835ce2c81906f36b74101a4c0fb matches inspected pre-edit source.
investigation.leading_hypothesis: Synchronous per-inference logging blocked the control thread. Independent exact Fable 5.2 review ranked this first. Delayed stop-log ordering supports it, but does not prove full-pipe backpressure in the incident. SPI blocking or scheduling remain alternatives.
